title: Post-treatment care plan — Sarah Okonkwo (tooth #19 root canal)

detail.description: Final restoration (crown) on tooth #19 by the patient's regular dental provider — the endodontically treated molar needs definitive coronal coverage.
Follow-up periapical radiograph of tooth #19 at 6 months to confirm periapical healing.
Post-operative discomfort: ibuprofen 400 mg by mouth as needed.

note.text: Post-treatment care plan surfaced to Sarah's patient-facing app alongside the referral-complete milestone at Interaction 4, and transmitted to the referring teledentistry provider as part of the closed-loop summary. Final restoration is deliberately deferred to the patient's regular dental provider (not Barton Springs), consistent with the operative note.
